## Highlights
### New
- Choose your default browsing engine and add, edit or remove website engine rules in Settings. Chromium is recommended, while WebKit offers native handling and FairPlay video.
### Improved
- WebKit sessions leave Chromium unloaded until you open a Chromium website or extension. Once loaded, it stays ready until you quit Crest. - The default Mac download includes Chromium and WebKit, with a separate WebKit build available. Each build keeps its own update channel. - The final experimental update moves your update preference to Development so future Crest updates continue there.
### Fixed
- Extensions can move, resize and restore Crest windows using their normal window controls.
---
This is the final experimental update. Installing it switches updates to Development, where future releases continue after this branch merges into main.
